description: Head-movement mini-game GA12: direction-memory game, closing Group B. Voice announces a fixed direction sequence (1 second apart, never shown on screen), then the player replays it step by step — each step turn, hold 0.8 s, return to center — in order. 3 rounds: left-up-right, down-left-down, right-down-left-up. Wrong direction fails the round at once; stall re-prompts once, never auto-fails. Dual-axis start calibration (look down, turn left) learns both signs. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: memory-seq
